SELECT COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0) FROM ai_usage_record WHERE usage_type = 'IMAGE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0) FROM ai_usage_record WHERE usage_type = 'TTS'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%m-%d') AS dayLabel, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_type = 'CHAT' THEN prompt_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_type = 'CHAT' THEN completion_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_type = 'IMAGE' THEN call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS imageCount FROM ai_usage_record WHERE stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(stat_date)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS dayLabel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM agent_message WHERE user_message IS NOT NULL AND user_message != '' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(create_time)
SELECT stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_info WHERE role_type = 1 AND stage IS NOT NULL AND stage != '' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, title AS title, message_count AS messageCount, DATE_FORMAT(last_message_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastMessageTime FROM agent_session WHERE last_message_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_message_time DESC LIMIT 5
